description: Wasana Trading Lanka (Private) Limited v. The Director General of the Customs Department and Others Wasana Trading Lanka (Private) Limited v. The Director General of the Customs Department and Others View More before S. Srikandarajah, J.
parties: Wasana Trading Lanka (Private) Limited v. The Director General of the Customs Department and Others Wasana Trading Lanka (Private) Limited v. The Director General of the Customs Department and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought to quash the decisions of the Customs Department demanding payment of Excise duty and other relevant levies imposed on the imported eleven seater vans under the new HS Code introduced. Held - writ issued since the Customs cannot recover or collect unpaid Excise duty after the removal of the goods in question from the Customs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
